Parse Hive DDL without recovery

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Tree\Sitter\Language\Pack\TreeSitterLanguagePack;
use Tree\Sitter\Language\Pack\Language;
use Tree\Sitter\Language\Pack\ProcessConfig;
use Tree\Sitter\Language\Pack\Tree;
$config = \Tree\Sitter\Language\Pack\ProcessConfig::from_json(json_encode(["language" => "sql"]));
$result = TreeSitterLanguagePack::process("CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE t(`a` string, `b` array<string>)\nPARTITIONED BY (`p` string)\nROW FORMAT SERDE 'org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.parquet.serde.ParquetHiveSerDe'\nSTORED AS INPUTFORMAT 'x' OUTPUTFORMAT 'y'\nLOCATION 's3://{{bucket}}/t/'\nTBLPROPERTIES ('k'='v');", $config);
var_dump($result->language);
var_dump($result->getMetrics()->errorCount);
var_dump($result->getMetrics()->totalBytes);
var_dump($result->getStructure());
var_dump($result->getStructure()[0]->name);
```
